In [[statistics]], an '''L-statistic''' is a [[statistic]] (function of a data set) that is a [[linear combination]] of [[order statistic]]s; the "L" is for "linear". These are more often referred to by narrower terms according to use, namely:

* [[L-estimator]], using L-statistics as estimators for parameters
* [[L-moment]], L-statistic analogs of the conventional moments
